# gologit2 and gsvy 3.2.8

Author: Richard Williams, University of Notre Dame. This directory includes the unmodified source and documentation extracted from the [author's version 3.2.8 distribution](https://academicweb.nd.edu/~rwilliam/gologit2/gologit2_ver3.2.8.zip). Source archive SHA-256: `7133878aa179c51d32f51e496263b2ba1cb3e90d24db272c50977471fb7a797d`.

The [upstream package listing](https://ideas.repec.org/c/boc/bocode/s453401.html) identifies the GNU General Public License version 3. The license text is included in [COPYING](COPYING). Cite Richard Williams, “GOLOGIT2: Stata module to estimate generalized logistic regression models for ordinal dependent variables,” Statistical Software Components S453401, and the [method paper](https://doi.org/10.1177/1536867X0600600104) as appropriate.
